BYgram plugin documentation

Build Android plugins in Python 3.11 with BYgram SDK v1.

Choose an API

Use bygram.Plugin for the native SDK. Existing exteraGram plugins can use the compatibility modules base_plugin, client_utils, file_utils and extera_utils.

Build a first plugin

Start with the package guide, then read the lifecycle reference. The BYgram catalog contains installable examples.

Port a project

Follow the Elyx project guide for structured archives or consult the individual compatibility API articles.
